**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**

- **Affected area**: Whole plant, with focus on the pseudostem and canopy
- **Key symptoms**:
  - Severe yellowing of outer/older leaves (chlorosis progressing from leaf margins inward)
  - Leaves wilting and collapsing downward around the pseudostem
  - Browning and rotting at the base of the pseudostem
  - Inner younger leaves still somewhat green but showing stress
  - Classic "skirt" pattern of collapsed leaves around the stem

**Differential reasoning:**
- **Panama Disease** (Fusarium wilt): Causes progressive yellowing starting from lower/outer leaves, leaf collapse, and pseudostem browning — **matches perfectly**
- **Bunchy Top**: Causes stunted growth with narrow, upright leaves with dark green streaks — doesn't match
- **Yellow & Black Sigatoka**: Causes streaking/spotting on leaf blades — doesn't match this whole-plant wilt pattern
- **Cordana Leaf Spot**: Causes discrete oval spots on leaves — doesn't match
- **Anthracnose**: Causes fruit/leaf lesions — doesn't match
- **Cigar End Rot**: Affects the fruit tip — doesn't match

The whole-plant wilting with progressive outer-leaf yellowing and pseudostem collapse is the hallmark presentation of Panama Disease (Fusarium oxysporum f.sp. cubense).
